# OS-QANET simulator check of the audit expectation E-PLAY-19 (docs/qa/og-user-audit/triage.md row 76): a beat slice plays to the end of its own slice and stops, and the next note on the track cuts it where that note starts.
# The card e2e_pro (e2e_pro_session.txt: Projects/Kit, GENERATED by `o3pj_tool gen kit`), instrument 3 PLUCK: a one shot of 11025 frames (250 ms), a sine of 441.18 Hz under a decay of e every 0.12 s. The CHOP page
# cuts it in two equal slices (EVEN 2), then splits slice 0 (ADD): slice 0 = 0..62.5 ms, slice 1 = 62.5..125 ms, slice 2 = 125..250 ms of the sample, so slice 2 sounds for 125 ms. In BEAT SLICE a pad writes note 24 + pad,
# so pad n is slice n (OS-SLICEFIX). The tempo is 400 BPM (a step is 37.5 ms).
document
wait 20
card e2e_pro
audio on
wait 20
tap file
wait 300
assert state screen=FILE sel=Kit
tap f1
wait 1500
assert state screen=PATTERN msg=PROJECT_Kit_OPENED
action instrument.select 3
tap sampleplay
assert state screen=WAVE
# (the screen's button again is the CHOP page)
tap sampleplay
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
action wave.even_n -1
tap f2
tap f4
assert model inst.3.play_mode=5
press pattern
wait 5
encoder 280
release pattern
assert model tempo=40000
tap pattern
assert state screen=PATTERN
# STEP: pad 2 (slice 2) at step 1, pad 0 (slice 0, 62.5 ms) at step 2, and pad 2 again alone at step 9.
tap rec
action cursor.jump_fraction 0
pad 2
assert model pat.1.0.0.note=27
pad 0
assert model pat.1.0.1.note=25
tap down 6
pad 2
assert model pat.1.0.8.note=27
tap rec
# (the pads also played the slices live; wait for them to end)
render quiet 500
wait 500
assert audio quiet in=400-500 silent
# Play: slice 2 starts at 0 and would sound until 125 ms, but the note at 37.5 ms (slice 0, 62.5 ms long) takes the track over: sound until 100 ms, then silence. Step 9 (300 ms) plays slice 2 alone: it sounds its
# whole 125 ms and stops at its own end (425 ms) with no note after it.
render song 500
tap play
assert state playing=1
wait 498
assert audio song in=5-95 sound pitch=441.18+-3c
assert audio song in=110-290 silent
assert audio song in=310-420 sound pitch=441.18+-3c
assert audio song in=440-495 silent
tap play
assert state playing=0
